name: Hey Stranger! I Dare You to Love Me!
source:
After a hair-raising moment on a dark, unfamiliar highway, you find yourself in the unorthodox town of Porte Avant: a place where sexual freedom reigns supreme! With many different locations to explore, each with its own unique vixen(s), you will need to pay attention to the locals' needs and choose your words carefully, lest you blow your chances at romance! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703220/Hey_Stranger_I_Dare_You_to_Love_Me/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在黑暗、陌生的高速公路上经历了令人毛骨悚然的时刻后，你发现自己来到了非正统的Porte Avant小镇：一个性自由至高无上的地方！有许多不同的地点可供探索，每个地点都有自己独特的泼妇，你需要注意当地人的需求并谨慎措辞，以免错过浪漫的机会！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703220/Hey_Stranger_I_Dare_You_to_Love_Me/]Steam[/url]]
